title: Invariance of CNF cost under relabeling
statement: For any CNF and any function from its variable type to another type, relabeling the variables by that function leaves the CNF cost unchanged, where cost is the sum over clauses of one plus the clause length.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF over a variable type
A function from that variable type to another type
